name: Triangle Counting and Listing
problem_statement: Count all unordered triples of vertices connected by all three possible edges and optionally list the triples or their per-vertex and per-edge participation counts.

normalization: Reject directed input unless an explicit undirected projection is requested.
Collapse parallel edges into one undirected edge.

problem_inputs.name: result_limit
problem_inputs.description: Maximum listed instances; it does not permit truncating the global count.

required_outputs.name: global_triangle_count
required_outputs.description: Exact number of distinct undirected triangles.

required_outputs.name: instances_complete
required_outputs.description: Whether every triangle instance was listed when listing was requested.

solution_semantics.objective: Count every size-three clique exactly once and materialize requested secondary outputs.
solution_semantics.exactness: The global count and requested participation counts are exact.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each unordered triple is counted and listed once.

validation_rules: Every listed triple contains three distinct pairwise-adjacent vertices.
The sum of per-vertex counts equals three times the global count.
The sum of per-edge counts equals three times the global count.
edge_cases: Graphs with fewer than three vertices have count zero.
A complete n-vertex graph contains n choose 3 triangles.
Isolated vertices have per-vertex count zero.
